name: Lasagna
tagline: A drag-and-drop editor for building, training and testing hybrid classical and quantum neural networks.
problem: Hybrid quantum-classical ML is hard to prototype.
solution: Drag PyTorch and PennyLane layers onto a canvas with real-time validation; the editor generates working code and trains it.
demo_moment: Team-described: assemble a hybrid model and train it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Moonshot Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Brings block-based building to quantum ML.

lessons: Visual editors lower the barrier to frontier tools.
